description: This file is a test mock for the 'accounts.js' module, used in unit testing with Vitest. It mocks various functions related to Zalouser accounts.

methods.name: listZalouserAccountIds
methods.description: Mocks returning a list containing the default account ID.

methods.name: resolveDefaultZalouserAccountId
methods.description: Mocks resolving to the default account ID.

methods.name: resolveZalouserAccountSync
methods.description: Mocks synchronously resolving to a default realized account object.

methods.name: resolveZalouserAccount
methods.description: Mocks asynchronously resolving to a default realized account object.

methods.name: listEnabledZalouserAccounts
methods.description: Mocks asynchronously returning a list with one default realized account object.

methods.name: getZcaUserInfo
methods.description: Mocks asynchronously returning null, indicating no user info.

methods.name: checkZcaAuthenticated
methods.description: Mocks asynchronously returning false, indicating user is not authenticated.
